liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Listener calls this performance an all-time great version of the song [19]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Jerry’s pedal steel performance is highlighted as a pure extension of his soul [13]

## The recordings

- **gd76-06-29.sbd.bertha.31144.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 177 min; rated 4.82/5 by 33 [1]
- **gd76-06-29.sbd.parrillo.1812.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 177 min; rated 4.58/5 by 36 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording has a laid-back vibe with good ensemble playing, particularly in the second set; Listener praises the 1976 intros to the song and notes a wonderful sound quality [12][14]
- **gd1976-06-29.sbd.bertha.ashley.86216.dvdf**: soundboard; 0 songs; 0 min [9]
- **gd1976-06-29.139633.sbd.betty.gastwirt.miller.clugston.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 176 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- Listener describes the song as beautiful and notes the second set has a killer feel [11]
- The performance was broadcast on WXRT-FM radio in Chicago [5]
- Show is compared to later Orpheum performances, featuring a long, trippy version of the material [16]
- The 1976 era is characterized by a laid-back, funky groove unlike other periods in the band's history [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-06-29.sbd.bertha.31144.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Audio transferred from SBD to MR, PCM, DAT, CDA, SHN, and DAW formats [1]
- **gd76-06-29.sbd.parrillo.1812.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Reviewer has possessed a tape copy of the board since the early 1980s [16]
- **gd1976-06-29.sbd.bertha.ashley.86216.dvdf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of the Master Reel Betty Board source [9]. Also: Digitally remastered in June 2005 using a custom dual-DAW system nicknamed Bertha [9]
- **gd1976-06-29.139633.sbd.betty.gastwirt.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor, provided by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: 7" two track Betty reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM > DAT; Transfer Info: DAT(Sony PCM-R500)-> Tascam DA-3000-> Adobe Audition-> TLH flac16; Transfer by… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [THE GRATEFUL DEAD - AUDITORIUM THEATRE, CHICAGO 29TH JUNE 1976 RECORD STORE DAY! | #4849303161](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-auditorium-theatre-4849303161) [23]
